t: Added InsufficientCapacityException to RunMicrovm for capacity-related failures. Added lifecycle status field (AVAILABLE, DEPRECATED) to ListManagedMicrovmImageVersions. Added ConflictException to CreateMicrovmAuthToken and CreateMicrovmShellAuthToken for unregistered MicroVMs.
Lambda MicroVMs GA launch. Lambda MicroVMs enable isolated and highly responsive execution of user-supplied or LLM-generated code.
